races.name: Dwarf
races.description:
## Dwarf Traits
Your dwarf character has an assortment of inborn abilities, part and parcel of dwarven nature.
races.ageDesc: **_Age._** Dwarves mature at the same rate as humans, but they're considered young until they reach the age of 50. On average, they live about 350 years.
races.alignmentDesc: **_Alignment._** Most dwarves are lawful, believing firmly in the benefits of a well-ordered society.
races.languagesDesc: **_Languages._** You can speak, read, and write Common and Dwarvish.
races.visionDesc: **_Darkvision._** Accustomed to life underground, you have superior vision in dark and dim conditions. You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. You can't discern color in darkness, only shades of gray.
races.asiDesc: **_Ability Score Increase._** Your Constitution score increases by 2.

traits.name: Ability Score Increase
traits.description: **_Ability Score Increase._** Your Constitution score increases by 2.

traits.name: Dwarven Resilience
traits.description: You have advantage on saving throws against poison, and you have resistance against poison damage.

traits.name: Dwarven Combat Training
traits.description: You have proficiency with the battleaxe, handaxe, light hammer, and warhammer.

traits.name: Tool Proficiency
traits.description: You gain proficiency with the artisan's tools of your choice: smith's tools, brewer's supplies, or mason's tools.

traits.name: Stonecunning
traits.description: Whenever you make an Intelligence (History) check related to the origin of stonework, you are considered proficient in the History skill and add double your proficiency bonus to the check, instead of your normal proficiency bonus.

subraces.name: Hill Dwarf
subraces.description: As a hill dwarf, you have keen senses, deep intuition, and remarkable resilience.
subraces.asiDesc: **_Ability Score Increase._** Your Wisdom score increases by 1

traits.name: Ability Score Increase
traits.description: **_Ability Score Increase._** Your Wisdom score increases by 1

traits.name: Dwarven Toughness
traits.description: Your hit point maximum increases by 1, and it increases by 1 every time you gain a level.

races.name: Elf
races.description:
## Elf Traits
Your elf character has a variety of natural abilities, the result of thousands of years of elven refinement.
races.ageDesc: **_Age._** Although elves reach physical maturity at about the same age as humans, the elven understanding of adulthood goes beyond physical growth.
races.alignmentDesc: **_Alignment._** Elves love freedom, variety, and self-expression, so they lean strongly toward the gentler aspects of chaos.
races.languagesDesc: **_Languages._** You can speak, read, and write Common and Elvish.
races.visionDesc: **_Darkvision._** Accustomed to twilit forests and the night sky, you have superior vision in dark and dim conditions. You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. You can't discern color in darkness, only shades of gray.
races.asiDesc: **_Ability Score Increase._** Your Dexterity score increases by 2.

traits.name: Ability Score Increase
traits.description: **_Ability Score Increase._** Your Dexterity score increases by 2.

traits.name: Keen Senses
traits.description: You have proficiency in the Perception skill.

traits.name: Fey Ancestry
traits.description: You have advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can't put you to sleep.

traits.name: Trance
traits.description: Elves don't need to sleep. Instead, they meditate deeply, remaining semiconscious, for 4 hours a day.

subraces.name: High Elf
subraces.description: As a high elf, you have a keen mind and a mastery of at least the basics of magic.
subraces.asiDesc: **_Ability Score Increase._** Your Intelligence score increases by 1.

traits.name: Ability Score Increase
traits.description: **_Ability Score Increase._** Your Intelligence score increases by 1.

traits.name: Elf Weapon Training
traits.description: You have proficiency with the longsword, shortsword, shortbow, and longbow.

traits.name: Cantrip
traits.description: You know one cantrip of your choice from the wizard spell list. Intelligence is your spellcasting ability for it.

grants.description: One cantrip of your choice from the wizard spell list.

traits.name: Extra Language
traits.description: You can speak, read, and write one extra language of your choice.

races.name: Half-Elf
races.description:
## Half-Elf Traits
Your half-elf character shares some qualities with elves and some that are unique to half-elves.
races.ageDesc: **_Age._** Half-elves mature at the same rate humans do and reach adulthood around the age of 20.
races.alignmentDesc: **_Alignment._** Half-elves share the chaotic bent of their elven heritage.
races.languagesDesc: **_Languages._** You can speak, read, and write Common, Elvish, and one extra language of your choice.
races.visionDesc: **_Darkvision._** Thanks to your elf blood, you have superior vision in dark and dim conditions.
races.asiDesc: **_Ability Score Increase._** Your Charisma score increases by 2, and two other ability scores of your choice increase by 1.

traits.name: Ability Score Increase
traits.description: **_Ability Score Increase._** Your Charisma score increases by 2, and two other ability scores of your choice increase by 1.

grants.description: Two other ability scores of your choice

traits.name: Fey Ancestry
traits.description: You have advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can't put you to sleep.

traits.name: Skill Versatility
traits.description: You gain proficiency in two skills of your choice.

traits.name: Extra Language
traits.description: You can speak, read, and write one extra language of your choice.

spells.name: Acid Splash
spells.description: You hurl a bubble of acid. Choose one creature within range, or choose two creatures within range that are within 5 feet of each other. A target must succeed on a dexterity saving throw or take 1d6 acid damage.
spells.shortDescription: 1 or 2 targets within 5 ft of each other; Dexterity save; 1d6 acid damage on fail
spells.higherLevel: This spell's damage increases by 1d6 when you reach 5th level (2d6), 11th level (3d6), and 17th level (4d6).

spells.name: Burning Hands
spells.description: As you hold your hands with thumbs touching and fingers spread, a thin sheet of flames shoots forth from your outstretched fingertips. Each creature in a 15-foot cone must make a Dexterity saving throw. A creature takes 3d6 fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
spells.shortDescription: 15-foot cone; Dexterity save; 3d6 fire damage, half on success; ignites flammable objects
spells.higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the damage increases by 1d6 for each slot level above 1st.

spells.name: Counterspell
spells.castingTime: 1 reaction, which you take when you see a creature within 60 feet of you casting a spell
spells.description: You attempt to interrupt a creature in the process of casting a spell. If the creature is casting a spell of 3rd level or lower, its spell fails and has no effect. If it is casting a spell of 4th level or higher, make an ability check using your spellcasting ability. The DC equals 10 + the spell's level. On a success, the creature's spell fails and has no effect.
spells.shortDescription: interrupt a creature casting a spell; auto-succeeds vs 3rd level or lower, ability check otherwise
spells.higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the interrupted spell has no effect if its level is less than or equal to the level of the spell slot you used.

spells.name: Detect Magic
spells.description: For the duration, you sense the presence of magic within 30 feet of you. If you sense magic in this way, you can use your action to see a faint aura around any visible creature or object in the area that bears magic.
spells.shortDescription: sense magic within 30 feet; action to see auras on visible magical creatures or objects

spells.name: Feather Fall
spells.material: a small feather or piece of down
spells.description: Choose up to five falling creatures within range. A falling creature's rate of descent slows to 60 feet per round until the spell ends. If the creature lands before the spell ends, it takes no falling damage and can land on its feet, and the spell ends for that creature.
spells.shortDescription: up to 5 falling creatures; descent slows to 60 ft/round; no falling damage if they land in time

spells.name: Fire Bolt
spells.description: You hurl a mote of fire at a creature or object within range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes 1d10 fire damage.
spells.shortDescription: ranged spell attack; 1d10 fire damage on hit
spells.higherLevel: This spell's damage increases by 1d10 when you reach 5th level (2d10), 11th level (3d10), and 17th level (4d10).

spells.name: Fireball
spells.material: A tiny ball of bat guano and sulfur.
spells.description: A bright streak flashes from your pointing finger to a point you choose within range and then blossoms with a low roar into an explosion of flame. Each creature in a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on that point must make a dexterity saving throw. A target takes 8d6 fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The fire spreads around corners. It ignites flammable objects in the area that aren't being worn or carried.
spells.shortDescription: 20-foot-radius sphere; Dexterity save; 8d6 fire damage, half on success; ignites flammable objects
spells.higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the damage increases by 1d6 for each slot level above 3rd.

spells.name: Fly
spells.material: A wing feather from any bird.
spells.description: You touch a willing creature. The target gains a flying speed of 60 feet for the duration. When the spell ends, the target falls if it is still aloft, unless it can stop the fall.
spells.shortDescription: willing creature gains 60 ft flying speed; falls when the spell ends if still aloft
spells.higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, you can target one additional creature for each slot level above 3rd.

spells.name: Hold Person
spells.material: A small, straight piece of iron.
spells.description: Choose a humanoid that you can see within range. The target must succeed on a wisdom saving throw or be paralyzed for the duration. At the end of each of its turns, the target can make another wisdom saving throw. On a success, the spell ends on the target.
spells.shortDescription: one humanoid; Wisdom save or paralyzed; repeat save at end of each turn
spells.higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, you can target one additional humanoid for each slot level above 2nd. The humanoids must be within 30 feet of each other when you target them.

spells.name: Identify
spells.material: a pearl worth at least 100 gp and an owl feather
spells.description: You choose one object that you must touch throughout the casting of the spell. If it is a magic item or some other magic-imbued object, you learn its properties and how to use them, whether it requires attunement, and how many charges it has, if any.
spells.shortDescription: touch an object to learn its magical properties, attunement needs, and charges

spells.name: Invisibility
spells.material: An eyelash encased in gum arabic.
spells.description: A creature you touch becomes invisible until the spell ends. Anything the target is wearing or carrying is invisible as long as it is on the target's person. The spell ends for a target that attacks or casts a spell.
spells.shortDescription: touched creature becomes invisible until it attacks or casts a spell
spells.higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, you can target one additional creature for each slot level above 2nd.

spells.name: Light
spells.description: You touch one object that is no larger than 10 feet in any dimension. Until the spell ends, the object sheds bright light in a 20-foot radius and dim light for an additional 20 feet.
spells.shortDescription: touched object sheds bright light 20 ft and dim light 20 ft more

spells.name: Lightning Bolt
spells.material: A bit of fur and a rod of amber, crystal, or glass.
spells.description: A stroke of lightning forming a line 100 feet long and 5 feet wide blasts out from you in a direction you choose. Each creature in the line must make a dexterity saving throw. A creature takes 8d6 lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The lightning ignites flammable objects in the area that aren't being worn or carried.
spells.shortDescription: 100-foot line, 5 ft wide; Dexterity save; 8d6 lightning damage, half on success
spells.higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the damage increases by 1d6 for each slot level above 3rd.

spells.name: Mage Armor
spells.description: You touch a willing creature who isn't wearing armor, and a protective magical force surrounds it until the spell ends. The target's base AC becomes 13 + its Dexterity modifier. The spell ends if the target dons armor or if you dismiss the spell as an action.
spells.shortDescription: willing unarmored creature; base AC becomes 13 + Dexterity modifier

spells.name: Mage Hand
spells.description: A spectral, floating hand appears at a point you choose within range. You can use the hand to manipulate an object, open an unlocked door or container, stow or retrieve an item from an open container, or pour the contents out of a vial.
spells.shortDescription: spectral hand manipulates objects, opens unlocked containers, or pours vials within range

spells.name: Magic Missile
spells.description: You create three glowing darts of magical force. Each dart hits a creature of your choice that you can see within range. A dart deals 1d4+1 force damage to its target. The darts all strike simultaneously, and you can direct them to hit one creature or several.
spells.shortDescription: three darts; each deals 1d4+1 force damage; hit automatically, can split targets
spells.higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the spell creates one more dart for each slot level above 1st.

spells.name: Misty Step
spells.description: Briefly surrounded by silvery mist, you teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space that you can see.
spells.shortDescription: bonus action teleport up to 30 feet to a seen unoccupied space

spells.name: Scorching Ray
spells.description: You create three rays of fire and hurl them at targets within range. You can hurl them at one target or several. Make a ranged spell attack for each ray. On a hit, the target takes 2d6 fire damage.
spells.shortDescription: three rays; ranged spell attack each; 2d6 fire damage on hit
spells.higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, you create one additional ray for each slot level above 2nd.

spells.name: Shield
spells.description: An invisible barrier of magical force appears and protects you. Until the start of your next turn, you have a +5 bonus to AC, including against the triggering attack, and you take no damage from magic missile.
spells.shortDescription: reaction; +5 AC until your next turn and immune to magic missile

spells.name: Sleep
spells.material: a pinch of fine sand, rose petals, or a cricket
spells.description: This spell sends creatures into a magical slumber. Roll 5d8; the total is how many hit points of creatures this spell can affect. Creatures within 20 feet of a point you choose within range are affected in ascending order of their current hit points.
spells.shortDescription: 5d8 HP of creatures in a 20-foot radius fall asleep, lowest HP first
spells.higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, roll an additional 2d8 for each slot level above 1st.

items.name: Abacus
items.description: An abacus.

items.name: Acid
items.description: As an action, you can splash the contents of this vial onto a creature within 5 feet of you or throw the vial up to 20 feet, shattering it on impact. In either case, make a ranged attack against a creature or object, treating the acid as an improvised weapon. On a hit, the target takes 2d6 acid damage.

items.name: Acid (vial)
items.description: As an action, you can splash the contents of this vial onto a creature within 5 feet of you or throw the vial up to 20 feet, shattering it on impact. In either case, make a ranged attack against a creature or object, treating the acid as an improvised weapon. On a hit, the target takes 2d6 acid damage.

items.name: Alchemist's Fire (Flask)
items.description: This sticky, adhesive fluid ignites when exposed to air. As an action, you can throw this flask up to 20 feet, shattering it on impact. Make a ranged attack against a creature or object, treating the alchemist's fire as an improvised weapon. On a hit, the target takes 1d4 fire damage at the start of each of its turns. A creature can end this damage by using its action to make a DC 10 Dexterity check to extinguish the flames.

items.name: Alchemist's Supplies
items.description:
These special tools include the items needed to pursue a craft or trade.\n\n
Proficiency with a set of artisan’s tools lets you add your proficiency bonus to any ability checks you make using the tools in your craft. Each type of artisan’s tools requires a separate proficiency.

items.name: Amulet
items.description: Can be used as a holy symbol.

items.name: Antitoxin (Vial)
items.description: A creature that drinks this vial of liquid gains advantage on saving throws against poison for 1 hour. It confers no benefit to undead or constructs.

items.name: Arrow (bow)
items.description: An arrow for a bow.

items.name: Assassin's Blood
items.description:
A creature subjected to this poison must make a DC 10 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it takes 6 (1d12) poison damage and is poisoned for 24 hours. On a successful save, the creature takes half damage and isn't poisoned.\n\n

**_Ingested._** A creature must swallow an entire dose of ingested poison to suffer its effects. The dose can be delivered in food or a liquid. You may decide that a partial dose has a reduced effect, such as allowing advantage on the saving throw or dealing only half damage on a failed save.

items.name: Backpack
items.description: A backpack. Capacity: 1 cubic foot/30 pounds of gear.

items.name: Bagpipes
items.description: Several of the most common types of musical instruments are shown on the table as examples. If you have proficiency with a given musical instrument, you can add your proficiency bonus to any ability checks you make to play music with the instrument. A bard can use a musical instrument as a spellcasting focus. Each type of musical instrument requires a separate proficiency.

items.name: Ball Bearings (bag of 1000)
items.description: As an action, you can spill these tiny metal balls from their pouch to cover a level, square area that is 10 feet on a side. A creature moving across the covered area must succeed on a DC 10 Dexterity saving throw or fall prone. A creature moving through the area at half speed doesn't need to make the save.

items.name: Barrel
items.description: A barrel. Capacity: 40 gallons liquid, 4 cubic feet solid.

items.name: Basket
items.description: A basket. Capacity: 2 cubic feet/40 pounds of gear.

items.name: Battleaxe
items.description: A battleaxe.

properties.name: Versatile
properties.description: This weapon can be used with one or two hands. A damage value in parentheses appears with the property—the damage when the weapon is used with two hands to make a melee attack.

items.name: Bedroll
items.description: A bedroll.

items.name: Bell
items.description: A bell.

items.name: Blanket
items.description: A blanket.

items.name: Block and Tackle
items.description: A set of pulleys with a cable threaded through them and a hook to attach to objects, a block and tackle allows you to hoist up to four times the weight you can normally lift.

items.name: Blowgun
items.description: A blowgun.

properties.name: Ammunition
properties.description:
You can use a weapon that has the ammunition property to make a ranged attack only if you have ammunition to fire from the weapon. Each time you attack with the weapon, you expend one piece of ammunition. Drawing the ammunition from a quiver, case, or other container is part of the attack (you need a free hand to load a one-­‐‑handed weapon). At the end of the battle, you can recover half your expended ammunition by taking a minute to search the battlefield.

If you use a weapon that has the ammunition property to make a melee attack, you treat the weapon as an improvised weapon (see “Improvised Weapons” later in the section). A sling must be loaded to deal any damage when used in this way.

properties.name: Loading
properties.description: Because of the time required to load this weapon, you can fire only one piece of ammunition from it when you use an action, bonus action, or reaction to fire it, regardless of the number of attacks you can normally make.

items.name: Blowgun needles
items.description: Needles to be fired with a blowgun.

items.name: Book
items.description: A book might contain poetry, historical accounts, information pertaining to a particular field of lore, diagrams and notes on gnomish contraptions, or just about anything else that can be represented using text or pictures. A book of spells is a spellbook (described later in this section).

items.name: Bottle, glass
items.description: A glass bottle. Capacity: 1.5 pints liquid.

items.name: Breastplate
items.description: This armor consists of a fitted metal chest piece worn with supple leather. Although it leaves the legs and arms relatively unprotected, this armor provides good protection for the wearer's vital organs while leaving the wearer relatively unencumbered.

items.name: Brewer's Supplies
items.description:
These special tools include the items needed to pursue a craft or trade.\n\n
Proficiency with a set of artisan’s tools lets you add your proficiency bonus to any ability checks you make using the tools in your craft. Each type of artisan’s tools requires a separate proficiency.

items.name: Bucket
items.description: A bucket. Capacity: 3 gallons liquid, 1/2 cubic foot solid.

items.name: Burnt othur fumes
items.description: A creature subjected to this poison must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or take 10 (3d6) poison damage, and must repeat the saving throw at the start of each of its turns. On each successive failed save, the character takes 3 (1d6) poison damage. After three successful saves, the poison ends.\n\n**_Inhaled._** These poisons are powders or gases that take effect when inhaled. Blowing the powder or releasing the gas subjects creatures in a 5-foot cube to its effect. The resulting cloud dissipates immediately afterward. Holding one's breath is ineffective against inhaled poisons, as they affect nasal membranes, tear ducts, and other parts of the body.

items.name: Calligrapher's supplies
items.description:
These special tools include the items needed to pursue a craft or trade.\n\n
Proficiency with a set of artisan’s tools lets you add your proficiency bonus to any ability checks you make using the tools in your craft. Each type of artisan’s tools requires a separate proficiency.

items.name: Caltrops (bag of 20)
items.description: As an action, you can spread a bag of caltrops to cover a square area that is 5 feet on a side. Any creature that enters the area must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or stop moving this turn and take 1 piercing damage. Taking this damage reduces the creature's walking speed by 10 feet until the creature regains at least 1 hit point. A creature moving through the area at half speed doesn't need to make the save.

items.name: Candle
items.description: For 1 hour, a candle sheds bright light in a 5-foot radius and dim light for an additional 5 feet.

items.name: Canvas
items.description: 1 sq. yd. of canvas

items.name: Carpenter's Tools

These special tools include the items needed to pursue a craft or trade.\n\n
Proficiency with a set of artisan’s tools lets you add your proficiency bonus to any ability checks you make using the tools in your craft. Each type of artisan’s tools requires a separate proficiency.

items.description: Drawn vehicle.

items.name: Case, Crossbow Bolt
items.description: This wooden case can hold up to twenty crossbow bolts.

items.name: Case, Map or Scroll
items.description: This cylindrical leather case can hold up to ten rolled-up sheets of paper or five rolled-up sheets of parchment.

items.name: Chain (10 feet)
items.description: A chain has 10 hit points. It can be burst with a successful DC 20 Strength check.

items.name: Chain mail
items.description: Made of interlocking metal rings, chain mail includes a layer of quilted fabric worn underneath the mail to prevent chafing and to cushion the impact of blows. The suit includes gauntlets.

items.name: Chain shirt
items.description: Made of interlocking metal rings, a chain shirt is worn between layers of clothing or leather. This armor offers modest protection to the wearer's upper body and allows the sound of the rings rubbing against one another to be muffled by outer layers.

items.name: Chalk (1 piece)
items.description: A piece of chalk.

items.name: Chariot
items.description: Drawn vehicle.

items.name: Chest
items.description: A chest. Capacity: 12 cubic feet/300 pounds of gear.

items.name: Chicken
items.description: One chicken

items.name: Cinnamon
items.description: 1lb of cinnamon

items.name: Climber's Kit
items.description: A climber's kit includes special pitons, boot tips, gloves, and a harness. You can use the climber's kit as an action to anchor yourself; when you do, you can't fall more than 25 feet from the point where you anchored yourself, and you can't climb more than 25 feet away from that point without undoing the anchor.

items.name: Clothes, Common
items.description: Common clothes.

items.name: Clothes, costume
items.description: A costume.

items.name: Clothes, fine
items.description: Fine clothing.

items.name: Clothes, traveler's
items.description: Traveler's clothing.

items.description: 1lb of cloves.

items.description: A club

items.name: Copper Piece
items.description: One silver piece is worth ten copper pieces, which are common among laborers and beggars. A single copper piece buys a candle, a torch, or a piece of chalk.

items.name: Cotton Cloth
items.description: 1 sq. yd. of cotton cloth.

items.name: Cow
items.description: One cow.

items.name: Crawler mucus
items.description:
This poison must be harvested from a dead or incapacitated crawler. A creature subjected to this poison must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 minute. The poisoned creature is paralyzed. The creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.\n\n
**_Contact._** Contact poison can be smeared on an object and remains potent until it is touched or washed off. A creature that touches contact poison with exposed skin suffers its effects.

items.description: Bolts to be used in a crossbow.

items.name: Crossbow, hand

\n\n

properties.name: Ammunition
properties.description:
You can use a weapon that has the ammunition property to make a ranged attack only if you have ammunition to fire from the weapon. Each time you attack with the weapon, you expend one piece of ammunition. Drawing the ammunition from a quiver, case, or other container is part of the attack (you need a free hand to load a one-­‐‑handed weapon). At the end of the battle, you can recover half your expended ammunition by taking a minute to search the battlefield.

If you use a weapon that has the ammunition property to make a melee attack, you treat the weapon as an improvised weapon (see “Improvised Weapons” later in the section). A sling must be loaded to deal any damage when used in this way.
